name: Cosyn Limited
about: Cosyn Limited provides information technology services to governments, universities, and enterprises in India. The company offers digiMoolyankan, a platform for evaluating pen and paper-based examinations on digital writing pads or computer screens; timeFrank, a cloud-based time and attendance tracking application; WellToDesk, a cloud based original format database for the storage of well data; and Smart Utilities - IoT products. It also provides digital transformation services, including simplified legacy environment and ubiquitous platform, as well as migration, modernization, and transformation services; cloud services, such as software driven business, intelligent analytics, IoT connected enterprise, modern infrastructure, and smart digital workplace; and intelligent automation solutions. The company was formerly known as CSS Technergy Limited and changed its name to Cosyn Limited in August 2015. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
